messages:
maria (sec): vendor (RedTeamCo) asked for a 24h testing window May 12-13. can we lock RBAC and avoid any user-facing key rotations during that window? also need to confirm audit log retention/export for evidence.

devin (eng): scope? which services and principals will they need access to?

maria (sec): app-control plane, staging + limited prod read-only for inference endpoints, and S3 readroom for logs. they requested KMS decrypt for artifacts they need to validate.

oliver (sre): prefer ephemeral roles via our STS proxy. we can create assessor roles with https://example.com/assessor-policy (internal) and timebox to 24h. no need to rotate primary KMS keys; instead create a grant scoped to the assessor role.

sarah (ops): audit log retention: default is 90 days in our ES cluster. we can do a one-off export to a presigned S3 bucket for the readroom and keep a 180-day copy if security wants. cc @maria (sec) for approval.

maria (sec): yes approve 180-day export. vendor must use read-only creds. no changes to RBAC during the window except emergency rollback path. we'll freeze deploys for the 24h window. :no_entry_sign:

ana: back on topic — we need to ensure model weights can't be pulled. recommend a sandbox tenant for any model-level tests. no access to S3 buckets with weights.

ana (ml) edit: ignore my earlier multi-post, brainfart.

ana (ml): ok sandbox + assessor role sounds good. we should also snapshot a small eval set for them so we can reproduce any findings.

pen-test-bot: Ticket PT-4321 created for "RedTeamCo May window" — assignee: maria (sec) — due: 2024-05-12.

devin (eng): for KMS grant, I'll request a scoped grant not a key rotation. sample CLI we can use for the grant:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-infra --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-role --operations "Decrypt" --constraints "{""EncryptionContextSubset"": {""purpose"": [""pen-test""]}}"
```

oliver (sre): for logs — plan: 1) snapshot ES indices 2) export snapshot to presigned S3 3) hand to RedTeam readroom bucket with auditing on that bucket (S3 object-level logs). I'll add a runbook for this.

sarah (ops): do we need to extend SIEM retention too? Looking at Splunk/Seq we can keep a 30-day hot copy and archive to S3 for the extra 150 days. that's extra cost but acceptable for compliance.

maria (sec): approve Splunk archive. please ensure we capture authn/authz events, KMS grant/usage events, and service-account activity. those are required for evidence.

devin (eng): scheduling question — vendor wants early morning start (02:00 UTC) to avoid traffic. can we provide that window?

oliver (sre): yes, devs + oncall can be on standby. will set up an emergency rollback procedure (quick RBAC revoke + revoke grants).

maria (sec): add a 'no RBAC changes' tag to any PRs during the freeze window. also make clear that emergency changes require sec + sre + product approval.

ana again accidental posts removed

maria (sec): retest coordination: if they validate fixes, vendor requests a retest slot within 7 days. we should hold 2 x 4h retest slots the week after window. who can own scheduling?

sarah (ops): I can own scheduling and calendar invites. will reserve two 4h blocks Weds/Thurs after the window.

devin (eng): for remediation tracking, create a vuln board with statuses: triage -> fix -> QA -> evidence -> retest. we'll link PRs and include repro steps.

maria (sec): agreed. also require a post-engagement evidence package: logs export, config snapshot, RBAC snapshot, KMS grant record.

pen-test-bot: PT-4321 updated: "evidence-package checklist added".

ana clean up: stop spamming — okay good

maria (sec): action items recap:
- devin: create assessor role + scoped KMS grant (provide IAM & grant ARNs)
- oliver: runbook for ES snapshot -> presigned S3 + S3 auditing
- sarah: calendar invites for freeze window + retest slots, Splunk archive config
- ana: prepare sandbox tenant and eval snapshot
- all: enforce no RBAC changes during window unless emergency-approved

devin (eng): noted, will post PRs and the IAM/Grant ARNs in PT-4321. :thumbsup:

oliver (sre): will post runbook and S3 presigned process in the ticket.

maria (sec): thanks — will do a final sign-off 48h before start.

pen-test-bot: Reminder scheduled 48h before 2024-05-10 02:00 UTC for PT-4321.
